title: Box eight
logline: Friday. The serious pages come off the wall. Into a box. The lid: BOX 8 · THE RIDGE · UNFINISHED. Wood, small, needs a chair to reach the top pin. The strip's Wood puts the novel away for good and is drawn too small to do it easily.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD, two-thirds, on a chair, unpinning the eight serious pages from the wall one at a time. BARNABY watching.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a small thin man standing on a chair to unpin dense cross-hatched comic pages from a garage wall, a dog watching

panels.composition: The pages going into a cardboard box, face down. The faller's ridge, the last one, face up for a beat.

panels.composition: The lid. Marker. BOX 8 · THE RIDGE · UNFINISHED. His hand small on the big marker.

panels.composition: The wall, bare, eight pale rectangles where the pages were. The box on the floor. The stick figure on the CRT. The small man. The normal dog. Four weeks of two-thirds left.
